description: Test a SKILL.md. No model, every call: lint (gate on lint.valid) and review (description lacks what/when, words shared with other_skills, leftovers, no done-check, missing files; why + fix each). Unless lint_only, a model picks a skill per request from names+descriptions: trigger_accuracy PASS ≥80, FIX ≥50, else BLOCK; your scenarios = gate, generated = signal; unanswered = INCONCLUSIVE. Server key 10 runs/day. mode "interview" (no skill_md): the questions to put to the person (never answer them yourself), then with answers: remarks per answer, the SKILL.md, scenarios for this tool and a starter .ia-eval.yaml.

examples.skill_md:
---
name: flaky-test-triage
description: Triage a flaky end-to-end test and write the failing step, the cause and a fix. Use when a test passes and fails without a code change.
---

1. Rerun the test ten times and count the failures.
2. Done when the report names the failing step and the count.

answers.description: Keyed by question id; each step can be sent alone.

name: test_skill
